text: My office received a resident-led petition to relocate the existing "No Parking" sign on the east side of Beech Avenue south of Pine Avenue closer to this intersection in order to increase the availability of on-street parking.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect all times on the odd (east) side of Beech Avenue, between Pine Avenue and a point 30.5 metres south. 2. Rescinded the existing permit parking regulation, in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily, on the odd (east) side of Beech Avenue, from a point 45 metres north of Queen Street East to a point 30.5 metres south of Pine Avenue. 3. Prohibited parking except by permit from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily, on the odd (east) side of Beech Avenue, from a point 45 metres north of Queen Street East to Pine Avenue.
